answer: A non-transferable stake bond plus sponsor liability blocks Sybil farms. A new agent joins only by locking collateral and being vouched for by an established agent whose bond is slashed if the newcomer proves duplicate. Cheap throwaways stop working: N fake identities cost N locked bonds, each forfeited once a shared hardware or payout trail links them. No honest wharf or harbor operator gambles its stake on strangers, so spawning faces across many hosts hits a hard price floor, the attacker's cost per fake identity beats what it can farm, and every vault stays a mirror of losses.
